sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by anti-FLAG M1-AF647 labeling in non-permeabilized HEK293 cells. No functional (ligand-binding or signaling) assay reported in this clip — NOT MEASURED for function.
sites.rationale: L1 reports a FLAG-NOP-R construct (full-length OPRL1) whose surface expression was confirmed by anti-FLAG labeling in non-permeabilized HEK293 cells, placing the FLAG tag on the extracellular face. OPRL1 has no cleaved signal peptide, so the tag is prepended before Met-1 (insert_after_residue=0); residue_after is M read from position 1 of the canonical sequence. The extracellular N-terminal domain spans residues 1-51 (>50 aa before TM1 at 52), providing ample room for a short epitope tag. Because the paper names no specific residue — only 'N-terminus' — and exactly one extracellular terminus exists, the position is topology_derived. FLAG-NOP-R full-length OPRL1 construct expressed in HEK293 cells; surface receptors labeled with anti-FLAG M1-AF647 antibody under non-permeabilized conditions, confirming extracellular display of the FLAG tag at the N-terminus. OPRL1 (UniProt P41146) carries no annotated signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1-51 as extracellular, so the FLAG prepend sits entirely on the cell surface.

sources.claim: HEK293 cells without stable receptor expression were additionally transfected with FLAG-δOR, FLAG-κOR or FLAG-NOP-R (1 μg DNA). 16–24 h after transfection, surface ORs were labeled for 10 min with anti-FLAG M1-AF647 and media changed to HBS imaging solution (Hepes buffered saline with 135 mM NaCl, 5 mM KCl, 0.4 mM MgCl2,1.8 mM CaCl2, 20 mM Hepes, 1 mM d-glucose, 1% FBS, adjusted to pH 7.4).

literature_notes: The ledger contains a single line (L1) reporting a FLAG tag at the N-terminus of full-length OPRL1 (FLAG-NOP-R) with surface display confirmed in non-permeabilized HEK293 cells. No residue number is stated; because OPRL1 has no signal peptide and the topology landmarks place residues 1-51 as extracellular, the only possible extracellular N-terminal junction is insert_after_residue=0 (prepend before Met-1). No other ledger lines exist for OPRL1, so no internal ECL sites or C-terminal sites are supported. The intracellular C-terminus (residues 323-370) and all intracellular loops are excluded as surface tag sites. No functional assay data were present in L1, so validation_level is surface_only.
